summary_markdown:
Reviewed **6** library items (4 footprints changed/added, 1 removed, 1 symbol).

- 1 item **fails**: `SW_SPST_Same-Sky_TS32_with-boss` references a 3D model file that is not in the repo.
- 3 items have warnings, mostly missing datasheet links and silkscreen clearance.
- The removed `SOP-8_3.76x4.96mm_P1.27mm` footprint may still be used by existing symbols; check before merging.

footprint:Custom_Package_SO:SOIC-8-1EP_3.summary: Exposed pad enlarged from 2.29×3.0 mm to **2.41×3.3 mm**, which matches the NS4168 datasheet thermal pad. `Value` still names the old EP size in some places and no paste reduction is applied to the large EP.

findings.message: EP paste aperture is 100% of the pad (2.41×3.3 mm). KLC F6.3 recommends segmenting paste on EPs larger than 2×2 mm to avoid float/voiding.
findings.suggestion: Add `(solder_paste_margin_ratio -0.2)` or split into 4 paste-only pads.

findings.message: Footprint name encodes EP size `EP2.41x3.3mm`; 3D model still points at the `EP2.29x3mm` STEP from the KiCad library.
Pin 1 pad changed from `rect` to `roundrect`; other pins are roundrect too, so this is now consistent.

footprint:Custom_Button_Switch_SMD:SW_SP.summary: Pad 2 moved 0.2 mm. That matches rev B of the Same Sky drawing, but the **3D model path** points at `TS32-7-35-BK-B-260-RA-SMT-TR.STEP`, and the old `_old.STEP` reference in base suggests a rename that did not land in `lib_3d/`.

findings.message: Model path case differs from file on disk on case-sensitive systems: footprint uses `.STEP`, check that CI and users on Linux resolve it.
findings.suggestion: Rename the file to `.step` or match the case exactly.

findings.message: `Datasheet` property is empty. Add the Same Sky TS32 datasheet URL.
Silkscreen line at y=-1.6 is 0.08 mm from pad 2 copper (min 0.2 mm recommended).

footprint:Custom_Buzzer_Beeper:MagneticB.summary: New right-angle buzzer footprint. THT pads, 2.5 mm drill spacing and courtyard match the CMT-9605-85T drawing.

findings.message: Datasheet URL is only in the description, not in the `Datasheet` property.
findings.suggestion: Copy the URL into the Datasheet property.

footprint:Custom_Connector_Card:microSD_.summary: New push-push microSD socket. Signal pad pitch (1.1 mm) is correct, but the pad-to-card-edge offset could not be verified: the datasheet drawing is low resolution.

findings.message: Could not find a datasheet in `datasheets/` or a URL; checks were done against the STEP model only.
F.Fab outline includes the card-ejected position. Good for mechanical review.

footprint:Custom_Package_SO:SOP-8_3.76x4.summary: Footprint removed. `lib_sch/` still has symbols whose `Footprint` property may reference `Custom_Package_SO:SOP-8_3.76x4.96mm_P1.27mm`.

findings.message: Deleting a footprint breaks any board or symbol that references it. Search the repo for `SOP-8_3.76x4.96mm_P1.27mm` before merging.

symbol:Custom_Audio:NS4168.summary: NS4168 I²S class-D amplifier. All 8 pins match the datasheet pinout; pin 2 renamed `WS` → `LRCLK` to match the datasheet naming.

findings.message: Pin 2 renamed from `WS` to `LRCLK`. Electrically identical, and it matches the datasheet.
Exposed pad (pin 9 on the SOIC-8-1EP package) is not represented as a pin; OK if it is tied to GND in the footprint only.

checks.name: Footprint property points to existing footprint
